config.label: Set to 1/true to refuse the fetchproxy bridge read (CI/headless)
config.description: Set to 1/true to refuse the fetchproxy bridge read (CI/headless). Tools then fail instead of reading a session. Defaults to false.

config.label: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge connects to (default 37149)
config.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge connects to (default 37149). Shared by every MCP on the machine.

config.label: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127
config.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback.

config.label: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/
config.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
